annotations.title: Compare rent or prices in two Korean areas

description: Median monthly rent, jeonse deposit and apartment sale price side by side for two areas of South Korea, from reported contracts (MOLIT). Fits choosing between two districts or cities.

area_a.description: A place in South Korea: "Korea" for the whole country, a province or city ("Seoul", "Busan", "Gyeonggi"), or a district, city or county ("Mapo-gu", "Gangnam", "Suwon-si", "마포구").

area_b.description: A place in South Korea: "Korea" for the whole country, a province or city ("Seoul", "Busan", "Gyeonggi"), or a district, city or county ("Mapo-gu", "Gangnam", "Suwon-si", "마포구").

province_a.description: Optional. The province or city the area is in, when its name exists in more than one ("Jung-gu" is in Seoul, Busan and other cities).
